description: Source code implementing custom memory allocation functions for Skia, including handling of malloc, calloc, realloc, and out-of-memory scenarios, with platform-specific considerations.

methods.name: throw_on_failure
methods.description: Checks if memory allocation failed and calls sk_out_of_memory if so.

methods.name: sk_abort_no_print
methods.description: Aborts the program without printing, with a unique static variable to prevent linker merging.

methods.name: sk_out_of_memory
methods.description: Handles out-of-memory situations by asserting and terminating.

methods.name: sk_realloc_throw
methods.description: Reallocates memory with exception on failure, handling zero size case.

methods.name: sk_free
methods.description: Frees allocated memory if pointer is not null.

methods.name: prevent_overcommit
methods.description: Touches memory to prevent overcommitting, with platform-specific behavior.

methods.name: malloc_throw
methods.description: Allocates memory with overcommit prevention, throws on failure.

methods.name: malloc_nothrow
methods.description: Allocates memory without throwing exceptions, platform-specific.

methods.name: calloc_throw
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory with overcommit prevention, throws on failure.

methods.name: calloc_nothrow
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: sk_malloc_flags
methods.description: Allocates memory based on flags for zero-initialization and throw behavior.
